meta_description: Affordable Flames are Leicester's trusted Gas Safe registered engineers. Boiler installs, servicing & repairs with same-day availability. Call for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Boilers, Servicing & Repairs
hero_subhead: Boiler broken or due a service? We offer fast, fairly priced gas work with no hidden charges across Leicester.
services_heading: Complete Gas Engineering Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full installations and annual safety checks, we cover every gas need for Leicester homeowners and landlords.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: We supply and fit A-rated energy-efficient boilers to suit your home and budget. All installations are Gas Safe certified and backed by manufacturer warranties.

services.title: Boiler Repair
services.desc: Whether your boiler has lost pressure, is making strange noises, or won't fire up, we diagnose and fix faults fast — often on the same day you call.

services.title: Boiler Servicing
services.desc: An annual boiler service keeps your system running safely and efficiently, helping you avoid costly breakdowns and keeping your warranty valid.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Landlord gas safety inspections and CP12 certificates issued promptly. We keep your property compliant and your tenants protected.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: Full central heating installations, power flushes, and system upgrades to improve efficiency and eliminate cold spots in every room.

services.title: Emergency Gas Works
services.desc: Suspected gas leak or sudden loss of heating? We offer priority emergency callouts across Leicester with rapid response times.

about_pullquote: We believe every Leicester home deserves safe, affordable gas work done right.
about_para_1: Affordable Flames was founded right here in Leicester with a straightforward mission: deliver high-quality gas engineering at prices local families can actually afford. Based on Sykefield Avenue in LE3, we've built our reputation street by street across the city, completing hundreds of boiler installations, servicing jobs, and emergency repairs for homeowners and landlords alike.
about_para_2: Every engineer on our team is Gas Safe registered, and we take compliance and safety seriously on every single job. Customers come back to us year after year because we're honest about costs upfront, we turn up when we say we will, and we leave your home exactly as we found it.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Affordable Flames

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service. My boiler packed in on a cold Monday morning and Affordable Flames had an engineer out by lunchtime. Diagnosed the fault quickly, had the part on the van, and it was sorted within the hour. Very reasonable price too — will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Used Affordable Flames for my annual boiler service and to sort out a dodgy radiator that had been cold at the bottom for ages. The engineer was polite, thorough, and explained everything clearly. Brilliant value and no pushy upselling. Highly recommend to anyone in Leicester.
reviews.author: Mohammed A.

reviews.text: As a landlord I need a reliable gas engineer I can trust to get my CP12 certificates done quickly and professionally. Affordable Flames are now my go-to every year. Always on time, always thorough, and the certificates are issued the same day. Couldn't ask for more.
reviews.author: David R.
